classification: matched allocation/resource diagnostic; no registered latency claim
isolation: fresh process per selector per leg; normal ABBA then allocator ABBA; all task CPU workloads serialized; host background uncontrolled
correctness: identical corpus, output bytes, plan topology and refusal gates across both builds; all raw vectors retained
acceptance: retain only if cumulative requested allocation volume and allocation count improve with unchanged bytes and typed bounds; review every >5% adverse paired resource or latency metric
latency_scope: 100 samples is diagnostic only, below the 500-sample release latency claim threshold; no allocator elapsed comparison
memory_scope: operation counters are allocator-request volume and live/peak snapshots; high-water snapshots are process-scoped, not per-operation peaks. /usr/bin/time maximum RSS includes corpus construction, gates and teardown
uncertainty: report each ABBA leg and same-revision drift; no pooled or universal speedup. Deterministic allocation differences may vary slightly with map iteration. Shared-host timing and RSS are descriptive
candidate_scope: if baseline trace confirms exact writer growth attribution, evaluate archive-limit-capped geometric growth and a final fallible exact copy when needed to avoid deliberately retaining spare capacity; no ownership authorization changes
